pages.text: $(bold)/opencubes inventory store|restore$()$(br)Dump or restore a player inventory (permission level 4).$(br2)$(bold)/opencubes flimflam <player> [effect]$()$(br)Force a tomfoolery effect.

$(bold)/opencubes luck <player> [amount]$()$(br)Read or modify flim-flam luck.$(br2)Most features have server config under $(code)opencubes-common.toml$().$(br2)Tomfoolery defaults to on, but the brick joke stays off until $(code)weAreSeriousPeople$() is set to $(code)false$().
